title: Dos huevos estrellados senor Lord
html_source:
Spanish for “two fried/cracked eggs sir/mister.” She follows the same line preceding with criada and before that of speaking on Italian and Spanish.

“Huevos” can be slang for testicles, furthering the sexual imagery.
